name: Rambus Inc.
sector: Semiconductors — memory interface chips & silicon IP
moat_justification: Moderate-strong niche moat: roughly 40% share of DDR5 registered clock drivers in a three-player oligopoly (Rambus, Renesas, Montage), a deep patent/IP portfolio monetized as royalties, and server-module qualification switching costs, with gross margin holding 75.3-80.2% over the last five fiscal years. Capped at 6, not 7+: the roic_proxy series in fundamentals.json only reached 18.0% in FY2025 after -4.4% (2020), 2.5% (2021), 9.3% (2022), 12.9% (2023) and 16.1% (2024) — high ROIC is recent, not proven through a cycle — and the franchise is a narrow niche exposed to DDR generation transitions, Montage/Renesas share fights, and bundled IP from larger rivals.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

DEBT_TAGS_BLANK: no debt tag reports for the latest fiscal year — net debt is UNKNOWN (not zero); no leverage verdict is possible from the engine, state the balance sheet from the filing in analysis.md
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 2.55 vs 3-yr median 1.42 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.8x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (7.5%) vs bull-case tier C (12.4%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: High-quality, debt-free memory-interface/IP franchise, moat 6/10 — at $87.25 it does not clear 15% (weighted IRR 10.3%, weighted IV@15% $49.42); it clears the 15% hurdle only at or below $49.42.
moat_for: ~40% share of DDR5 RCDs in a three-player oligopoly (Rambus / Renesas / Montage) — every DDR5 server module needs an RCD
Patent and silicon-IP portfolio generating high-margin royalty and licensing revenue; consolidated gross margin 79.6% in FY2025
Qualification / design-in switching costs at DRAM makers and module vendors; standards and signal-integrity expertise at high data rates
Debt-free balance sheet and rising returns: roic_proxy 12.9% → 16.1% → 18.0% over FY2023-25
moat_against: Narrow niche TAM — one product family (memory interface) drives the story; DDR6 / new form-factor transitions reset share
Montage and Renesas contest the same RCD sockets; Synopsys / Cadence bundle competing IP with EDA
Customer and end-market concentration: server DRAM cycle and AI data-center capex drive demand
High ROIC is recent (roic_proxy was -4.4% in 2020 and 2.5% in 2021) — not yet proven through a downcycle
SBC is a persistent real cost: $54,267,000 in FY2025, 15.1% of operating cash flow
